guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

sourcedSteps.title: Visit the Push Portal
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Push Portal rewards page and log in with a wallet or a social account. If you farmed Season 1 or 2, use the same wallet so your earlier points carry over.

sourcedSteps.title: Verify your social accounts
sourcedSteps.body: Follow PushChain on X and join the Push Chain Discord , then complete verification inside the portal. This unlocks the quest board and referral link.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim testnet PC from the faucet
sourcedSteps.body: Click the wallet icon inside the portal to open the faucet and claim 1 free PC token. The faucet resets every 6 hours, so grab it a few times a day to keep enough gas for the onchain quests.

sourcedSteps.title: Complete the universal app challenges
sourcedSteps.body: Work through the quests attached to each app in the weekly rotation: play, or predict, depending on the app. These challenges are the main XP source in Season 3.

sourcedSteps.title: Check in daily
sourcedSteps.body: Hit the daily check-in whenever you open the portal. Streaks stack a bonus on top of the base reward, and a missed day resets it.

sourcedSteps.title: Use the daily spin
sourcedSteps.body: The Spin 2 Win wheel pays out Rare Passes, testnet $PC, and other rewards once per day. It takes a few seconds and is one of the few pass sources outside of leveling.

sourcedSteps.title: Collect Rare Passes
sourcedSteps.body: Stack as many Rare Passes as you can through level ups and spins. All passes get burned at TGE for a shot at a Shiny Pass, and the bigger your stash, the better your odds.

sourcedSteps.title: Invite friends
sourcedSteps.body: Share your referral link from the portal. You earn 16% of the points your invites generate and another 8% from the people they invite. Extra invite slots unlock as your referrals reach level 7, so help your invites stay active.

sourcedSteps.title: Climb the leaderboard
sourcedSteps.body: Leaderboards are live and track actual network usage. A higher rank heading into TGE positions you for a larger share of the season allocation.
